description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on patient recovery and well-being.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist to implement treatment plans, assist patients in regaining daily living skills, and document progress. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this full-time position.
requirements: Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.
